title: Mobility Equipment Field Service Standard — Wheel-Bench Allowance for Caster Work
content:
# Wheel-Bench Allowance — Caster Work on Mobility Equipment

**Standard.** A wheel-bench allowance is added to the labor units claimed from the manufacturer for a warranty tire or caster replacement on a Mobility Equipment chair, for where the caster work is done: 1 unit when a loaner chair has been delivered for the chair, 2 units when no loaner chair has been delivered and its own delivery (its purchase or initial rental delivery, not a loaner delivery) was into the home with training, and nothing otherwise.

## Records read

- **Loaner chair delivered** — a delivery in the chair's service history whose purpose is a loaner chair.
- **Own delivery into the home with training** — the chair's purchase delivery or initial rental delivery recorded with the mode in-home delivery with training; a loaner delivery is not the chair's own delivery.

## Decision table

| Loaner chair delivered for the chair | Own delivery into the home with training | Wheel-bench allowance |
|---|---|---|
| yes | either | 1 unit |
| no | yes | 2 units |
| no | no (courier, branch pickup) | none |

## Hypothetical case

A chair handed over at the branch, with no loaner ever delivered for it: none. The same chair after a loaner was delivered while it was in for repair: 1 unit.
